reaction: The finished carrier was satisfying to imagine; fitting the loop felt worthwhile because it made the trolley move.

mostWorthwhile.text: Hanging the trolley and then fitting the loop were the most worthwhile parts: the assembly led to a carrier that could deliver a biscuit. Playing through felt worth the effort, though the steps themselves were very straightforward.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the crank and wheel felt routine, although both had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The final description clarified how the separate loop moves the trolley along the support cord and brings it back.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt purposeless; each added a recognizable part of the carrier.

continue.text: I probably would not choose another chapter: the finished carrier was pleasing, but following the assembly goals offered little decision-making.
